source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            fill = 2 if (r1 - r0 + 1) % 2 == 0 and (c1 - c0 + 1) % 2 == 0 else 7
            for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    if grid[y][x] == background:
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
